categorization_rules_target_check.name: categorization_rules_target_check
categorization_rules_target_check.value:
("categorization_rules"."match_type" = 'merchant' and "categorization_rules"."merchant_id" is not null and "categorization_rules"."pattern" is null)
        or ("categorization_rules"."match_type" <> 'merchant' and "categorization_rules"."merchant_id" is null and btrim(coalesce("categorization_rules"."pattern", '')) <> '')

merchants_logo_data_check.name: merchants_logo_data_check
merchants_logo_data_check.value:
("merchants"."logo_data" is null and "merchants"."logo_content_type" is null)
        or ("merchants"."logo_content_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp')
            and octet_length("merchants"."logo_data") <= 262144)

recurring_rules_sign_check.name: recurring_rules_sign_check
recurring_rules_sign_check.value:
("recurring_rules"."kind" = 'expense' and "recurring_rules"."amount_cents" < 0 and "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is null)
        or ("recurring_rules"."kind" = 'income' and "recurring_rules"."amount_cents" > 0 and "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is null)
        or ("recurring_rules"."kind" = 'transfer' and "recurring_rules"."amount_cents" < 0 and "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" is not null
            and "recurring_rules"."to_account_id" <> "recurring_rules"."account_id")

transactions_sign_check.name: transactions_sign_check
transactions_sign_check.value:
("transactions"."kind" = 'expense' and "transactions"."amount_cents" < 0)
        or ("transactions"."kind" in ('income', 'reimbursement', 'refund') and "transactions"."amount_cents" > 0)
        or ("transactions"."kind" = 'transfer' and "transactions"."amount_cents" <> 0)

jobs_lock_check.name: jobs_lock_check
jobs_lock_check.value: "jobs"."status" <> 'running' or ("jobs"."locked_at" is not null and "jobs"."locked_by" is not null)

logo_cache_payload_check.name: logo_cache_payload_check
logo_cache_payload_check.value:
("logo_cache"."status" = 'ok' and "logo_cache"."data" is not null and "logo_cache"."content_type" is not null
            and octet_length("logo_cache"."data") <= 65536)
        or ("logo_cache"."status" = 'missing' and "logo_cache"."data" is null)
